HTTP verifies 5,060 selected-game sessions and notes, every cumulative snapshot value, real activity and $400,000 across 40,000 transactions. Both 1920x1080 native surfaces exercise production Details, Activity and Spending; fullscreen includes the source weekly Activity operation. Operation-wide factory instrumentation records actual repository leases, elapsed time and lease process IDs; native compares these with actual backend and renderer process IDs. The source ten-second guard remains at repository-lease boundaries and all observed leases stay outside the renderer. Renderer input/heartbeat, action-to-ready and API timings are recorded measurements, not invented hard UI-gap or total-duration limits. Component checks retain exact ownership-volume projection and verify range/focus/acknowledgement-only presentation updates reuse projections while new history invalidates them. Inactive journal rows and closed recorded-hours rows defer rendering; explicit disclosure tests still reveal all 5,000 distinct observations, preserve first/last records and selection, and reopen without losing the selected range.
